FAST.description: Lowest latency (<1.5s TTFT), high-throughput responses for quick edits and queries
FAST.fallback_behavior: Immediate failover to secondary model on 5xx, timeout, or rate-limit

CODING.description: High intelligence, robust tool/function calling, large context, reliable syntax generation
CODING.fallback_behavior: Failover to Auto or Flash-Lite with exponential backoff

REASONING.description: Complex logic, deep architectural synthesis, bug root cause analysis
REASONING.fallback_behavior: Preserve context tokens and retry on alternative high-capacity reasoning model

DEEP_REASONING.description: Complex logic, deep architectural synthesis, bug root cause analysis (alias for REASONING)
DEEP_REASONING.fallback_behavior: Preserve context tokens and retry on alternative high-capacity reasoning model

LONG_CONTEXT.description: Repository-scale analysis requiring 256k to 1M token context windows
LONG_CONTEXT.fallback_behavior: Failover strictly to models supporting high context capacity

GENERAL.description: Default balanced daily driver for interactive agent sessions
GENERAL.fallback_behavior: Auto-selection with cascading fallbacks across available quota pools

FALLBACK.description: Universal emergency fallback route when primary models hit rate limits or downtime
FALLBACK.fallback_behavior: Sequential progression through high-availability free tier endpoints

TOOL_USE.description: Strict function calling and structured tool execution for autonomous loops
TOOL_USE.fallback_behavior: Filter only to models with validated JSON schema function calling support

RESEARCH.description: Broad information gathering, synthesis, and documentation formatting
RESEARCH.fallback_behavior: Cascade through high-throughput fast completion models

LOCAL.description: Local offline execution via local Qwen bridge or local inference
LOCAL.fallback_behavior: If local bridge process is offline, gracefully fall back to FreeLLMAPI Qwen/Auto

blocked_or_quarantined_models.reason: Officially deprecated by Google upstream (Google API error 404: This model models/gemini-2.5-flash is no longer available to new users).
Exhausted upstream providers (429 quota limit on ElectronHub, empty completions on Groq & Cloudflare, rate limits on Ollama, bad request on Sail). Produces HTTP 502 Bad Gateway.
Alias to gpt-oss-120b. Upstream empty completion / exhausted quotas causing HTTP 502.
Upstream empty completion during streaming requests (HTTP 502).
Extreme upstream latency (170s-350s) and frequent stream resets.
Severely truncated context window (24k tokens) causing HTTP 413 context errors on coding tasks.
